concerns.text: Task T101 (Streaming Data Loader Implementation) does not specify generating N=10 samples per input nor performing AST‑based clustering required by FR‑001. This weakens the functional requirement for entropy extraction.

Task T508 (Non‑Inferiority Tests) checks router FLOPs against the Oracle baseline, but Constitution Principle VII mandates comparison only to the static k=2 baseline. This violates the constitution and FR‑006.

Task T601 (Per‑Stratum Correlation Powered Strata Only) explicitly skips strata with fewer than 50 samples, contradicting FR‑007 sub‑requirement (3) which requires inclusion of all strata via a hierarchical mixed‑effects model.
Task T602 (Holm‑Bonferroni on Powered Strata) inherits the same omission of low‑sample strata, further violating FR‑007.
Task T034 aggregates SC‑005 metrics, yet no preceding task records total runtime or GPU‑memory usage required by SC‑005, making the success criterion untestable.
